[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Canary Deployments and Progressive Delivery in CI/CD"},{"order":2,"type":"subheading","text":"Introduction"},{"order":3,"type":"paragraph","text":"In modern software development, continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines automate the delivery of code from repositories to production. However, deploying new versions instantly to all users carries inherent risks. Canary deployments and progressive delivery mitigate these risks by releasing updates to a small subset of users before a full rollout."},{"order":4,"type":"subheading","text":"What is a Canary Deployment?"},{"order":5,"type":"paragraph","text":"A canary deployment is a risk mitigation technique where a new application version (the canary) is deployed alongside the existing stable version. A fraction of production traffic is then routed to the canary. This allows teams to monitor performance metrics, error rates, and user feedback in a real-world environment without impacting the entire user base."},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Gradual Traffic Shifting: Route 5%, 25%, 50%, and eventually 100% of traffic to the new version."},{"order":7,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Automated Rollback: Instantly revert traffic to the stable version if health metrics degrade."},{"order":8,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Real-time Monitoring: Analyze latency, CPU utilization, and application logs during the rollout."},{"order":9,"type":"subheading","text":"Implementing Canary Deployments with Kubernetes and Argo Rollouts"},{"order":10,"type":"paragraph","text":"Argo Rollouts is a Kubernetes controller that provides progressive delivery features, including canary deployments and blue-green updates. Below is an example of a Rollout resource configuration."},{"order":11,"type":"code","text":"apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Rollout
metadata:
  name: example-app
spec:
  replicas: 5
  strategy:
    canary:
      steps:
      - setWeight: 20
      - pause: {duration: 10m}
      - setWeight: 50
      - pause: {duration: 30m}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: example-app
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: example-app
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: app
        image: my-app:v2.0.0"},{"order":12,"type":"subheading","text":"Automated Analysis and Metrics"},{"order":13,"type":"paragraph","text":"Progressive delivery relies heavily on observability. By integrating Prometheus or Datadog into your deployment pipeline, the CI/CD system can automatically judge the health of a canary release before promoting it."},{"order":14,"type":"code","text":"apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: AnalysisTemplate
metadata:
  name: success-rate
spec:
  metrics:
  - name: success-rate
    interval: 30s
    successCondition: result[0] >= 0.99
    provider:
      prometheus:
        address: http://prometheus.monitoring.svc:9090
        query: |
          sum(rate(http_requests_total{status=~"2.*"}[1m]))
          /
          sum(rate(http_requests_total[1m]))"},{"order":15,"type":"subheading","text":"Conclusion"},{"order":16,"type":"paragraph","text":"Canary deployments and progressive delivery transform CI/CD pipelines from static deployment engines into intelligent, self-healing systems. By combining automated traffic shifting with robust metric analysis, engineering teams can ship code faster and with significantly lower operational risk."}]
